verdict.rationale: Coinbase's x402 docs describe an official Bazaar MCP server that lets an MCP-compatible agent discover payable x402 services through tool calls, and name it as a first-party discovery channel alongside the CDP APIs and AgentCore. The core of the story is delivered, but the documented scope covers discovery only, and the evidence is thin on setup and tooling detail. Missing for 10: MCP server setup and connection documentation, a documented tool list beyond discovery (e.g., paying via MCP tools), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server itself (the runtime probe tested only the REST discovery API).
